title: ICF-Native Single-Case Clinical-Reasoning Tools for Rehabilitation
text: ICF-native, single-case clinical-reasoning tools rehabilitation. Rehabilitation reasons differently disease medicine: targets disability life reconstruction, evaluates individual rather randomised group, combines qualitative judgement quantitative signals, delivered allied-health professionals (PT / OT / ST) varied statistical backgrounds. PhysioRehab re-centres physiological measurement around way reasoning: anchors measures goals International Classification Functioning (ICF), detects change single-case methods, keeps clinician loop, drafts ICF-structured progress note.

title: ICF-Native Single-Case Clinical-Reasoning Tools for Rehabilitation
ICF-Native Single-Case Clinical-Reasoning Tools for Rehabilitation
text: core single guided workflow: runnable end--end example included: simulates chronic-stroke, left-hemiplegia single case (AB design, 12 sessions), runs workflow, writes two clinician-facing artefacts — auto-drafted, ICF-structured progress note single-case trajectory plot.
code: measure the individual over time against personal goals   -> detect change defensibly with single-case methods (NAP + MCID + 2-SD band)   -> visualise against ICF and the trajectory   -> auto-draft an ICF-structured progress note library(PhysioRehab)  ep  <- simulate_stroke_gait_case()          # a synthetic single case hyp <- rehab_hypothesis("task-oriented training improves gait",                         expect_speed_mcid = TRUE, expect_icf = c(d450 = 1)) res <- rehab_workflow(ep, hyp)              # analyse -> reason -> plot -> draft  cat(res$report)                             # the ICF-structured progress note res$plot_file                               # the single-case trajectory plot Rscript inst/examples/run_demo.R

title: ICF-Native Single-Case Clinical-Reasoning Tools for Rehabilitation

title: ICF-Native Single-Case Clinical-Reasoning Tools for Rehabilitation
text: PhysioRehab builds x-biosignal ecosystem rather reimplementing : Single-case statistics — PhysioAppKit (NAP effect size, threshold--band analysis; reconciled PhysioClinStats::scedNAP). ICF ontology — PhysioAnnotationHub (icf_for_measure() resolves measure ICF codes maintained ontology). Real signals — PhysioMoCap (markerless gait via add_session_from_mocap()) PhysioEMG (muscle fatigue via add_session_from_emg()). Ordinal--interval measurement — Rasch calibration via PhysioAppKit. Reporting — PhysioReport.

title: ICF-Native Single-Case Clinical-Reasoning Tools for Rehabilitation
text: Early-stage (0.1.0). bundled examples use synthetic data; worked instance stroke hemiplegic gait, framework condition-agnostic. PhysioRehab research tool measurement, documentation, clinician---loop reasoning support. medical device intended diagnosis; final clinical judgement rests clinician.

title: PhysioRehab 0.1.0
text: First public release. ICF-native semantic layer: icf_catalog(), icf_qualifier_label(), icf_change(), icf_for_measure() resolving measures ICF codes via PhysioAnnotationHub ontology (local fallback). Individualised single-case container: new_rehab_episode(), add_session(), Goal Attainment Scaling goals (rehab_goal()). 2-SD band) clinician---loop reasoning scaffold (rehab_hypothesis(), evaluate_hypothesis()) honestly flags unsupported claims. Auto-drafted, ICF-structured progress note: draft_progress_note(); guided one-call rehab_workflow(); trajectory plot (plot_trajectory()). Real-signal adapters: mocap_gait_measures() / add_session_from_mocap() (markerless gait via PhysioMoCap) emg_fatigue_measures() / add_session_from_emg() (muscle fatigue via PhysioEMG). clinician GUI (rehab_app() / launch_rehab_app(), Shiny) whose actions mirror equivalent R code. Worked instance: stroke hemiplegic gait (simulate_stroke_gait_case()).
